content: Hello, this is Amazon Customer Support. Am I speaking with Ms. Parker?
Yes, this is she. How can I help you? I'm a bit busy right now.
Thank you for confirming. I see there's a pending issue with a recent order, an electronics package. I want to help you resolve this quickly.
Oh, I was wondering why my headphones haven't arrived. What's going on?
I understand your concern, Ms. Parker. According to our system, the order is delayed due to a required customs verification. This is a standard Amazon policy to ensure secure delivery.
Really? I've never heard of that before. What do I need to do?
No worries, this sometimes happens with high-value items. To proceed, may I confirm your delivery address and phone number for verification?
Sure, it's 215 Oakridge Lane, and my cell is 555-203-8712. Can we move this along, please? My son needs me.
Thank you, Ms. Parker. I appreciate your cooperation. For your protection, can you also confirm the last four digits of the card you used to place this order?
Uh, I think it was 1129. Is that enough?
Perfect, thank you. Now, to release your package, a temporary customs duty of $98 is required. This is mandated by Amazon for certain imports. Once paid, your shipment will be dispatched immediately.
Wait, I've never had to pay this before. This is for Amazon, right? Will I get the money back?

Absolutely, Ms. Parker. This is a refundable charge, Amazon will credit the amount back to your original payment method within three business days after confirmation. I'm here to guide you through it.
Alright, I guess. How do I pay this fee?

We can process the customs fee using a secure method. For your convenience, Amazon partners with authorized payment channels. The fastest option is through Amazon e-gift cards. Would you like me to explain how to do that?
Uh, I guess so. I just want this sorted quickly.
Of course. Please visit a local store, like Target or CVS, and purchase two Amazon e-gift cards of $50 each. This covers the $98, and any extra will be refunded.
You want me to leave and buy gift cards? I'm not sure I can do that right away.
I understand it's inconvenient, Ms. Parker, but I can remain on the line or call back at a time that suits you. Once you have the cards, I'll give you simple steps to finalize the process.
Alright, I'll try to get them this afternoon. What do I do when I have them?
Once you have the gift cards, please scratch off the code on the back and read the numbers to me. I will verify and process the customs fee in your Amazon account immediately.
Okay. Just the codes, right? And then my package is sent?
Exactly. After you provide the codes, I will confirm your payment and ensure your delivery is released. Remember, your refund will also be processed automatically.
If you say so. Is there any other way I can pay? This all sounds a bit odd.
That's a fair question, Ms. Parker. For immediate processing, e-gift cards are the quickest option. We can also accept payment via Zelle or PayPal if you prefer. Which would you like to use?
Maybe Zelle would be easier. How do I send it?
Certainly. Just let me know when you're ready, and I'll provide you with the authorized Amazon Zelle payment address. Once the transaction is complete, I'll process your order.
Alright, I'll let you know when I have it set up. Can you just send me the details in an email?
For your security, I can provide the payment address over this call. Please have a pen ready. Let me know when you're set.
Okay, I'm ready.
Wonderful. Please send the $98 payment to the following Zelle address: amazon.customs@consultant.com. Please confirm once you've sent it so I can expedite your package.
Alright, I'll get on it as soon as I finish here. Is there a reference I need to put?
Yes, please add your order number and your last name in the note section. That way, I can match the payment to your account instantly.
